n = int(input())

# Read probabilities and convert to modular form
p = 10**9 + 7
inv_100 = pow(100, p - 2, p)

f = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    row = list(map(int, input().split()))
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        f[i][j] = (row[j - 1] * inv_100) % p

# Initialize variables
max_mask = 1 << n
s = [bin(i).count('1') for i in range(max_mask)]
q = [[0] * (max_mask + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
e = [0] * (n + 1)
ans = [[0] * (max_mask + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
wq = [[0] * (max_mask + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
rt = [{} for _ in range(n + 1)]

# Process node function
def process_node(u):
    q[u][0] = 0
    os = 0
    of = 0
    for i in range(max_mask):
        if s[i] == u:
            q[u][0] += 1
            q[u][q[u][0]] = i
            os += 1
    for i in range(1, e[u - 1] + 1):
        if ans[u - 1][i] == 0:
            continue
        for h in range(1, 1 << u):
            opq = 1
            for c in range(n):
                if (h & (1 << c)):
                    opq = (opq * f[u][c + 1]) % p
                else:
                    opq = (opq * (1 - f[u][c + 1] + p) % p) % p
            c = wq[u - 1][i]
            hc = c[:]
            tg = False
            for x in range(1, q[u - 1][0] + 1):
                if hc[q[u - 1][x]] == 1:
                    for t in range(n):
                        if ( (1 << t) & h ) and not (q[u - 1][x] & (1 << t)):
                            hc[q[u - 1][x] | (1 << t)] = 1
                            tg = True
            if not tg:
                continue
            hc_tuple = tuple(hc)
            if hc_tuple not in rt[u]:
                rt[u][hc_tuple] = of + 1
                e[u] += 1
                wq[u][e[u]] = list(hc)
                of += 1
            pos = rt[u][hc_tuple]
            ans[u][pos] = (ans[u][pos] + opq * ans[u - 1][i]) % p

# Initialize for node 0
q[0][0] = 1
e[0] = 1
ans[0][1] = 1
wq[0][1] = [0] * (max_mask)
wq[0][1][1] = 1

# Run process for each node
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    process_node(i)

print(ans[n][1])
